# mtncloud_identity_sources (Data Source)

Lists your identity sources, including those made in the console. Identity sources let users log in through your Active Directory or a SAML provider. Their credentials are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_identity_sources" "all" {}

output "identity_sources" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_identity_sources.all.identity_sources : x.id => { name = x.name, type = x.type } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return identity sources whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `identity_sources` (Attributes List) The identity sources, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identity_sources))

<a id="nestedatt--identity_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `identity_sources`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether it is active.
- `code` (String) Code.
- `default_role` (String) Role given to users no mapping applies to.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `external_login` (Boolean) Whether users log in on the provider's page.
- `id` (Number) ID of the identity source.
- `login_url` (String) Login URL, or empty.
- `name` (String) Name of the identity source.
- `subdomain` (String) Tenant subdomain users log in with.
- `type` (String) Type, for example `activeDirectory` or `saml`.
